reply_text:
*Hold the merge.* Reviewed `feature-flags-rules` at `e3396ff` against `main`; found two rollout-safety issues.

1. *Critical — rules leak between independent flags* — `flags/registry.py:13–15`
   The default `rules=[]` is shared across calls. Creating a second flag adds its rule to the first flag too.
   *Verified:* an `internal-only` flag restricted to staff starts accepting free-plan users after creating a separate free-plan flag.
   *Recommended fix:* use `None` as the default and allocate a fresh list per independent flag. Add a regression test creating two flags without explicit rule lists; the current registry tests always pass lists and miss this.

2. *Matching regression — absent fields can satisfy string rules* — `flags/match.py:2`
   Stringifying `context.get(k)` turns missing fields and explicit `None` into `"none"`. Consequently, `matches({'cohort': 'none'}, {})` now returns `True`; on `main` it returns `False`. This can enable a rollout for users without the targeting field.
   *Recommended fix:* distinguish missing/null values before normalization, retaining the intended case-insensitive string/integer matching. Test missing and null contexts against the literal `"none"`.

All five existing tests pass; both issues were reproduced separately. No code changes made; working tree is clean.
